name: vitap-connect
description: VITAP Connect full-stack Web Technology class project

scripts.install:all: npm.cmd --prefix frontend install && npm.cmd --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm.cmd --prefix backend run dev" "npm.cmd --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run seed:admin
scripts.docker:remove-demo: docker compose exec backend npm run remove-demo -- --apply
